components.name: Site header
components.description: Brand + primary navigation. Rendered at the top of every page via _layout.twig.

components.name: Site footer
components.description: Closing slab: copyright. Rendered at the bottom of every page via _layout.twig.

components.name: Button
components.description: Action button or link. <Button label="Save" variant="primary" size="md" href="/go" />. variant: primary|secondary|ghost|danger, size: sm|md|lg.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status pill. <Badge label="New" variant="success" />. variant: neutral|brand|success|warning|danger|info.

components.name: Card
components.description: Content card, optionally a link with an image. <Card title="Title" body="Text" eyebrow="Label" image="/x.jpg" href="/go" />.

sample.title: Ship without a build step
sample.body: Server-rendered Twig components you drop straight into content.

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline message banner. <Alert variant="success" title="Saved" body="Your changes were stored." />. variant: info|success|warning|danger.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: User avatar; falls back to initials when no image. <Avatar src="/me.jpg" name="Marko" size="lg" />. size: sm|md|lg.

components.name: Hero
components.description: Full-width hero band with optional background image + CTA. <Hero eyebrow="Intro" title="Headline" subtitle="Sub" cta_label="Go" cta_href="/start" image="/bg.jpg" />.

sample.title: Build faster with Kit
sample.subtitle: Prop-driven Twig components you copy straight into your content.

components.name: CTA band
components.description: Call-to-action strip with a button. <Cta title="Ready?" body="Sub" button_label="Start" button_href="/go" />.

sample.title: Ready to ship?
sample.body: Activate the Kit theme and start composing.

components.name: Stat
components.description: Single metric with a label. <Stat value="98%" label="Uptime" />.

components.name: Feature
components.description: Icon + title + text block for feature grids. <Feature icon="⚡" title="Fast" body="No build step." />.

sample.title: Fast by default
sample.body: No build step — components render on the server.

components.name: Input field
components.description: Labeled text input with optional hint. <Input label="Email" name="email" type="email" placeholder="you@x.com" hint="Never shared" />.
